description: This file contains a class 'ComplexTypeBenchmarks' that performs performance benchmarking and testing of Orleans serialization and copying for complex object graphs, including structs and classes with circular references. It uses BenchmarkDotNet and Xunit for benchmarking and testing, respectively.

classes.name: ComplexTypeBenchmarks
classes.description: A benchmarking class for measuring Orleans serialization performance on complex object graphs, including methods for serialization, copying, and round-trip testing.

methods.name: SerializeComplex
methods.description: Serializes the '_value' object and then deserializes it to test serialization correctness.

methods.name: CopyComplex
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the '_value' object.

methods.name: CopyComplexStruct
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the '_structValue' struct.

methods.name: OrleansStructRoundTrip
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a 'SimpleStruct' to measure round-trip performance.

methods.name: OrleansClassRoundTrip
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a 'ComplexClass' object to measure round-trip performance.

methods.name: OrleansSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the '_value' object and returns the session.

methods.name: OrleansDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the object from the stored serialized payload.

methods.name: OrleansReadEachByte
methods.description: Reads each byte of the serialized payload individually, XORs them, and returns the checksum.
